verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents an agent that auto-remediates level 1 alerts and escalates complex cases to humans. Reviewers can review and remediate cases, alerts and risks in the web app or via the API and set case decisions, and a case audit-trail endpoint returns the case's history. The evidence never shows a human overriding an AI-made remediation, or the AI's original evidence and rationale being kept alongside an override. missing for 10: documented override of agent auto-remediation decisions, explicit preservation of the AI's original evidence/rationale after override, audit trail shown to capture AI vs. human decisions, hands-on corroboration.
